run_detectFaces_cli: run detectFaces.py to track faces in a video and output speaker crops and landmarks
build_face2head_boxes: build square head boxes from face detection bounding boxes with a configurable scale factor
test_bb_intersection_over_union: test the bb_intersection_over_union function to compute IoU between two bounding boxes
refactor_face2head_scale: refactor face2head to support arbitrary aspect-ratio expansion instead of square boxes
review_main_face_tracking: review the main function that tracks faces across video frames using MTCNN and face alignment
